title: Dash direction is not normalized for fractional inputs or remembered facing
expected: 14 m/s for 12 ticks regardless of nonzero direction magnitude
actual: moveX=0.5 travels 1.4m in 12 ticks (7m/s), including idle dash after partial movement; expected 2.8m
priority: P1: normalize nonzero dash/facing direction separately from analogue run magnitude; retain speed/duration/cooldown constants

title: Unlisted post-dash velocity tail exceeds normal movement/stop requirement
expected: Outside dash/pad/wind/charm, normal run is6m/s and stopping takes <=0.1s
actual: After12 dash ticks and6 released-input ticks, speed is8m/s; first normal tick is13m/s
priority: P1: define/reset controlled run velocity at dash completion and test return-to-run/stop; also regress pad landing without changing standard tuning

title: Returning below island surface teleports the player upward through terrain
expected: Gravity-only re-entry below a solid top must not snap upward to a support above the feet
actual: Default-input Core trajectory tick425 jumps fromY=-1.2833 atX40.05 toY0 atX39.95. Native browser observations also jump fromY=-1.8056 to0 without jump/respawn
priority: P1: use previous-to-current vertical crossing/contact direction when choosing support; cover outer boundaries and raised-platform undersides

title: Coincident chasing Drifter does not move after pulse changes it to flee
expected: Flee moves away at7m/s, including degenerate coincident position
actual: D1 remains(0,0,0) for60ticks after pulse, instead of moving7m
priority: P2: choose a stable unit fallback flee direction at coincidence, as the contact path already does

title: Output validator accepts malformed known-v1.1 event payloads
expected: Published charm_picked/drifter_steal/night_start/fall-hit payload fields checked by the internal validator
actual: Accepts charm_picked with no payload, negative theft/string carried, night4 and fall hit without lost
priority: P2: validate the published per-event fields/types/ranges; keep unknown v1.0 base explicitly unverified

title: Dash FX class permanently hides later wind-warning/gust feedback
expected: Warning leaves remain visible2s before wind after normal use of dash; later FX can animate
actual: Night3 tick1705: class="dash warning", opacity0, animation="dashfx" while toast says wind warning. Dash class is added and never expired; forwards animation wins over wind/pulse/hurt
priority: P1: expire/reset dash class or separate independently composited FX layers; regress dash -> warning/gust/pulse/hurt

title: Partially charged but unlit lantern violates canonical unlit base color
actual: Actual renderer material for L2 at3/10 is#FFE58A. Per-channel absolute differences are164,134,28, exceeding tolerance
priority: P2: retain canonical unlit cage color and show partial charge through the existing progress indicator
